translations.title: Fexofenadine Hydrochloride 60 mg Tablet
translations.efficacy: This medicine is used for the temporary relief of a runny nose, sneezing, itchy and watery eyes, and an itchy nose or throat caused by pollen allergy or other upper-airway allergies.
translations.usage: Adults and adolescents aged 12 and over take one tablet with water every 12 hours, not exceeding two tablets in 24 hours. Do not take it with grapefruit, orange, or apple juice or with antacids, and do not drink alcohol while taking it.
translations.caution: Do not take this if you are allergic to it or if you are breastfeeding. Talk to a pharmacist before taking it if you are under 12 years old, have kidney problems, are elderly, have cardiovascular disease, or are pregnant. Do not take it together with other antihistamine-containing medicines such as cold remedies or cough-and-cold products.

summaryTable.Main symptoms: Runny nose, sneezing, watery eyes, and itching from an upper-airway allergy
summaryTable.Who should be careful: People with kidney problems and women who are breastfeeding
